items.title: First Cousins: QB to get start vs. Packers in Vikings return
items.description: Coach Kevin O'Connell called Kirk Cousins' ability to get reacquainted with the Vikings' offense "impressive."

items.title: 49ers OT Williams, LB Greenlaw questionable, WR Evans out vs. Cowboys
items.description: The 49ers are listing left tackle Trent Williams and linebacker Dre Greenlaw as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, while receiver Mike Evans has been ruled out.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: No injury designation
items.description:

items.title: Injured QB Jackson doing 'well' as Ravens eye 6-10 weeks out, Minter says
items.description: Ravens coach Jesse Minter's update on Lamar Jackson's recovery process calls such timelines "challenging to predict."

items.title: George Pickens: Clear for return in Week 10

items.title: Chiefs RB Walker (groin) misses practice, status uncertain vs. Falcons
items.description: Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III missed practice Friday with a sore groin, leaving his status for Sunday's matchup against the Falcons in question.

items.title: Veteran receiver Brown gets his wish, released by Eagles
items.description: Receiver Hollywood Brown, who has played sparingly over the first half of the season, has been released by the Eagles upon his request.

items.title: Independent experts to play role in Hurts review, NFL says
items.description: The NFL provided some additional details about the investigation into how Jalen Hurts' blood clots were handled in response to an inquiry from a U.S. senator.

items.title: Jaguars holding out new players Davis, Bates to give them bye
items.description: The Jaguars are holding out newly acquired Jordan Davis and Jessie Bates to give them a bye week.
